main_text.l: XXXIV. dicta huc revocanda sunt. Propalatio occultorum scanda-
lum parit. Illud vero, ceu Ecclesiæ noxium, vitari, quantum fieri
poteft, debet, adhibitis gradibus, quos Christus ipse Matth.XVIII.15.
&c. præscripsit. Eodem faciunt argumenta, quibus delationis offi-
cium à Pastore supra removimus.
XLIII. Providè igitur Serenissimi Electoris Brandenburgici
Friderici Wilhelmi, Seculi nostri Herculis, Constitutiones Ecclesiasti-
cæ Marcanæ & Clivenses, sic § 136. sanciunt: Die jenige betreffend/

l.bl: welche in lehr oder leben irren / und unrichtig wandlen / deren sünde
und fehler doch noch zur zeit verborgen wären/sollen die Prediger auch
verborgen seyn lassen/ihnen aber ihre sünden vorhalten/und davon

main_text.l: abzustehen sie fleissig in aller stille vermahnen; hoc est, Quantum ad il-

main_text.l: men & errores occulti adhuc sunt, eorum (peccata & errores) Pastores

l.i: Ecclesiæ in occulto latere sinant, ita tamen, ut eadem peccata illis exprobrent, &

main_text.l: eosdem, ut iis abstineant, diligenter magnoque cum silentio admoneant. Cui
Sanctioni conformis est Ampl. Magistratus nostri lex Consistorialis
vicesima secunda, qua Pastori Ecclesiæ potestas conceditur, peccato-
res sibi singulariter notos vel indicatos seorsim accersendi, & eosdem
salutari admonitione corrigendi (durch die Oberfeitliche Still
stands-ordnung sol einem Pfarzer nicht benommen seyn / die jenige/
so ihm sonderbar bekannt sind / oder gemacht worden / sonderbar zu-
beschicken /und mit heilsamem zusprechen zuverbesserẽ.) Estque hæc,
nisi fallor Ecclesiarum Protestantium constans & perpetua praxis,
adeò ut ne Gallicanæ quidem Ecclesiæ,cùm imperio heterodoxo &
tyrannico adhuc obnoxiæ fuissent, ad occulta ejusmodi, quatenus
statum publicum non feriebant,reseranda obstrictæ fuerint.
XLIV. Sed fortè Pastor Ecclesiæ officii sui in corripiendis
pro suggestu etiam peccatoribus & scandalis, tum à populo, tum à
Magistratu ipso manantibus, palàm pulsandis & corrigendis partes
obire non poterit, nisi scandalorum illorum authores σημειῶν notare,
& ad Magistratum etiam deferre velit & possit. Hoc scilicet illud
est,quod à Pastoribus exigere quandóque audent illi, qui correptio-

stitiam,aliáque ejusmodi palam & impunè grassantia, Ecclesiæ Mi-
nistri pro suggestu detonant. Nos quidem probare non possumus

page.notes: Black letter marks the German passages. The line-end hyphens in the margin note and in the Latin are printed hyphens and are kept. The text is cut off after "Still"; the rest of the sentence is in part 2. Top lines are the end of a paragraph begun on the previous page. Doubtful readings: "ἁγονδεάλας" (Greek word, marked [?]); the Greek after "authores" is read as σημειῶν. "zuverbesserẽ" has a tilde-like mark over the final e, copied as printed. The printed line ends "nitio-" continues on the next page. Left margin note text is small italic and was joined into one note; its hyphenated line breaks were resolved (e.g. "Magi-stratum", "pu-blicè").
